items.exampleEn: Grandma looks after my baby sister on weekdays.
items.exampleZh: 奶奶平日照顧我的小妹妹。

items.exampleEn: Please pick up the paper on the floor.
He put on his best shirt for the party.
items.exampleZh: 他為了派對穿上最好的襯衫。

items.exampleEn: She put down her bag and sat on the sofa.
items.exampleZh: 她放下包包，坐到沙發上。

items.exampleEn: Mom asked me to put away the clean clothes.
items.exampleZh: 媽媽叫我把乾淨的衣服收好。

items.exampleEn: Everyone sat down when the teacher came in.
items.exampleZh: 老師進來時，大家都坐下了。

items.exampleEn: Slow down! The road is wet.

items.sentenceEn: Dad will pick us up at the station.

items.audioEn: Please put your phone away during the test.
items.audioZh: 考試的時候請把手機收起來。
items.questionZh: 說話的人要大家考試時做什麼？
options: Keep their phones out of sight
Write their names on the test paper
Sit quietly in the front row

items.sentenceEn: Can you look after my cat this weekend?
items.sentenceZh: 你這個週末可以幫我照顧貓嗎？

items.sentenceEn: The driver slowed the bus down and stopped at the corner.
items.sentenceZh: 司機讓公車慢下來，停在轉角。

items.stemEn: Your hands will get cold. Please ____ these gloves.
items.stemZh: 你的手會冷，請戴上這雙手套。

items.stemEn: There's an empty chair here. Please ____.
items.stemZh: 這裡有一張空椅子，請坐。

items.passageEn: Every Sunday, Mia looks after her little cousin, Leo. Leo is very energetic and plays with his toys all over the house. When it is time for lunch, Mia says, "Let's pick the toys up and put them away." Leo always helps her. After lunch, they sit down and read a book together. Mia's aunt says Mia is very helpful.
items.passageZh: 每個星期天，Mia 都會照顧她的小表弟 Leo。Leo 精力很充沛，在屋子裡到處玩玩具。到了午餐時間，Mia 說：「我們把玩具撿起來收好吧。」Leo 總是會幫她。吃完午餐，他們坐下來一起看書。Mia 的阿姨說 Mia 很會幫忙。

questions.questionZh: Mia 每個星期天做什麼？
吃完午餐後，他們做什麼？

items.promptZh: 我妹妹自己穿上了鞋子。
referenceEn: My sister put on her shoes by herself.
My little sister put her shoes on by herself.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 put on her shoes、put her shoes on 等，受詞可放後面或中間
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 got her shoes on 等）也算對
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 put on、has put on 等）
「自己」可寫，例如 by herself、herself 等；「妹妹」例如 sister、little sister 等

items.promptZh: 請把你的書放下，看著我。
referenceEn: Please put down your book and look at me.
Please put your book down and look at me.
Put your book down and look at me, please.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 put down your book、put your book down 等，受詞可放後面或中間
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 set your book down、put your book on the desk 等）也算對
「看著我」可寫，例如 look at me 等
